Its research suggests future AI worms could run on consumer hardware rather than depend on a data center, making them harder to shut down through a single central service. items.description: Three vulnerabilities in LG's webOS can be chained to give an attacker on the same local network root access to certain smart TVs without a PIN or any interaction from the owner. LG has issued a fix, according to an advisory published by SSD Secure Disclosure on October 12. items.title: Attackers Heat French Supermarket Fridges Up to 50°C by Hijacking Danfoss Controllers
items.description: Attackers took remote control of fridges and freezers at hundreds of French supermarkets on the night of October 11 and warmed them, forcing stores to throw food away, several retail chains said. The attackers reached them through the controller that runs all of a store's fridges and freezers, a device made by Danish company Danfoss that maintenance firms can manage remotely.
